snippet.title: The Flamethrower is ready! A big update against the monsters of Cyborg3003 - Vulcano Trailer
snippet.description:
Cyborg3003 UPDATE LIST:

Hello, this time I bring you the Vulcano map, a map of fire, prepared for you to face the hordes of monsters, which are increasingly difficult. And also, of course, a new weapon couldn't be missing, the Flamethrower, that weapon we love to use against aliens.

This is another continuation of Cyborg3003, among some bug fixes and improvements, we have:

1 - Eruptia map improved performance by 30%
2 - Flashlight fix for Sniperblast in first person view when aiming
3 - Itens now has a unique flash visual location to help visualize
4 - Improved animation of the dragon when receiving shots
5 - Improved water visual
6 - Localization was also made for Japanese and Russian, which were the other countries that are playing Cyborg3003 the most, following the English, Portuguese and Spanish languages, which were already in the game.

We also have 2 more achievements on Steam, beating the final boss with Flamethrower, guaranteeing Flamethrower GOLD and winning 4 attack waves on the new Vulcano map.

As always, I'm following your comments and adjusting the game with time. Thanks a lot and let's make Cyborg3003 the best game possible.
